run_sample_questions_for_hits: run the script to sample questions from a pruned JSON set for Amazon Mechanical Turk HITs
generate_questions_for_hits: generate a sampled set of questions for HITs by randomly selecting from templates with per-env limits
collapse_question_type: collapse granular question type labels like exist_positive into broader categories like exist
get_template_to_question_mapping: build a mapping from question templates to unique question strings filtered by accepted questions
get_question_to_instances_mapping: build a mapping from each unique question string to all its instances in the question set
